scenario.name: work_mem_spill
scenario.about: work_mem is cut on the server: the order ranking report spills its sort to disk, and the top-customers report switches to a slower plan.

queries.text:
SELECT customer_id, sum(total) AS spend FROM shop.orders WHERE created_at >= now() - $1::interval
				GROUP BY customer_id ORDER BY spend DESC LIMIT $2

SELECT id, customer_id, total, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY total DESC) AS r
				FROM shop.orders WHERE created_at >= now() - $1::interval ORDER BY r, id LIMIT $2
SELECT product_id, qty FROM shop.order_items WHERE order_id = $1
SELECT id, total, status FROM shop.orders WHERE customer_id = $1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT $2
SELECT name, price, stock FROM shop.products WHERE id = $1
UPDATE shop.products SET stock = stock - $2 WHERE id = $1
SELECT id, name, price FROM shop.products WHERE id = ANY($1)

insights.query:
SELECT id, customer_id, total, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY status ORDER BY total DESC) AS r
				FROM shop.orders WHERE created_at >= now() - $1::interval ORDER BY r, id LIMIT $2

cause.summary: work_mem dropped from 64MB to 64kB, so sorts and hashes spill to disk

evidence: mean time 71.38 ms -> 87.74 ms (1.2x) over 8 calls
insights.planAfter:
Limit  (rows=10000 cost=26175.6)
  Sort  (rows=100000 cost=26400.6)
    WindowAgg  (rows=100000 cost=17845.8)
      Sort  (rows=100000 cost=16095.8)
        Seq Scan on orders  (rows=100000 cost=7541.0)

suggestion.text: Restore work_mem where it was changed.
suggestion.sql: -- where it was changed: SET work_mem = '64MB'

insights.verification: back to 63.78 ms from a worst of 108.47 ms (baseline 71.38 ms); after work_mem changed to 65536
